entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I... I need to return something. I'm just so confused by everything on the website. I don't know what to do.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so. It's... VF886-01. I think.
Thank you. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for one VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on January 5th. That was 15 days ago. Is that correct?

Oh, yes, I know I'm late. It's just... we had a major family emergency. My son's deployment got moved up unexpectedly, and right after that my husband had to be rushed to the hospital for an emergency surgery. I haven't had a moment to even think about this.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everyone is doing okay now. To help you with the return, I just need to ask, is there a technical fault with the band or is it more of a preference issue?
I... I honestly don't even know. I haven't opened the box. With everything that's been going on, it's just not the right time for me. I'm so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. Please give me one moment to review the return eligibility for your item.
Okay, I've just checked our policy here... and actually, you have nothing to worry about.

Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery. Since you received it just 15 days ago, you are unfortunately outside that timeframe. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh! Really? Are you sure? That's... that's such a huge relief. I was so worried I had missed the chance. Thank you.

You are very welcome. I'm sending the return instructions and a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account now. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed.
Thank you so much, Diana. You've really made my day a little easier.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
